behaviour: A rich, creamy white liquid squeezed from grated coconut flesh. It carries spice and sweetness into a curry or a soup, thickens as it simmers, and can split if it is boiled hard. The thick part rises to the top of a tin and the thin part stays below.

contains.basis: It is pressed from coconut, which some lists count as a tree nut; recorded strictly.
Recorded strictly: some sold coconut milk is kept with sulphites.
